column3: requireInvitationGrantScopesValid (#3554 review follow-up 2, v0.96 backport) is an early refusal only: it keeps an invitation whose grant the role-scope check would refuse from creating an account and spending the link. It is not load-bearing: every grant applyInvitationGrants then writes re-runs requireScopeValidForRole at its own write. On v0.96 the verdict depends only on the role name (immutable) and the scope, so it cannot change between the two.
